reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core finding and proposed mechanism from P21 (and related passages P3, P9, P20), which already demonstrated that severe plastic deformation refines grains to the nanocrystalline regime, leading to inverse Hall-Petch softening, amorphization, low friction, and high wear resistance in a CoCrFeMnNi HEA. The hypothesis merely rephrases this as a prediction without adding new materials, conditions, or mechanistic links beyond what is already reported.
copied_elements: severe plastic deformation to refine grain size below ~20 nm
switch from dislocation-mediated plasticity to grain boundary sliding
lower friction and enhanced wear resistance
